hello_world.title: HELLO WORLD
hello_world.description:
The 2019 anime film Hello World belongs to the Sci-Fi (Science Fiction), Romance, and Drama genres, with elements of Time Travel and Psychological mystery.

Key Details

• Genre Classification: Sci-Fi, Romance, Drama, and Time Travel
• Format: Animated Feature Film (Movie)
• Director: Tomohiko Itō
• Studio: Graphinica
• Premise: Set in a futuristic Kyoto in 2027, a socially awkward high schooler named Naomi Katagaki meets his future self from 10 years ahead. Together, they try to alter a tragic event involving his classmate Ruri Ichigyou while discovering that their reality is a complex quantum computer simulation.
